title: Nubank appoints Circle's Sarah Wilson chief legal officer
snippet: Nubank, the largest digital bank in Latin America, today announced the appointment of Sarah Wilson as Chief Legal Officer (CLO), effective September 28th.

title: Latin American fintech Skalar emerges from stealth
snippet: Skalar, a fintech company creating a new way to finance growth-stage technology startups, today emerged from stealth with more than US$125 million in committed deployments across six businesses, a seed round led by Monashees, and a capital partnership with General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund.

title: Apple Teams With Axis Bank for Long-Awaited Apple Pay Debut in India
snippet: Apple is preparing to launch Apple Pay in India in partnership with Mumbai-based Axis Bank, Reuters reported Friday (Sept. 18), citing unnamed sources. Axis Bank is the first lender in India to partner with Apple on Apple Pay, according to the report. title: Want to get off gas? Learn how at Drive Electric Month events across the US
snippet: Drive Electric Month continues this week with over 150 online and in-person events celebrating electric vehicles through most of September and the start of October. Events will be held for the next few weekends, with events in most US states, and one in Canada.
